messages.author: 5d2910e022d63c1b
messages.subject: No replicates
parts:
Hi I don't have any replicates in my data can I still use methylkit for my analysis. I am getting lot of methylation sites qualified as DMR when I am doing this p-values of lot of them are not significant (< = 0.01). If I take only the ones which have p-value less than 0.01 I get less than 1000 loci (DMR). Kindly suggest what can I do to get a more confident list of DMR when I don't have replicates.

regards
